- How & Where was the data collected?
The data was collected using convenience sampling by surveying people in the Heartside, Creston/Belknap, Baxter/Madison, & Burton Heights neighborhood along with individuals that utilize the Streams/Catherines services. 

- Why was the data collected?
The data was collected in order to gather health information about the community members living in the Townline neighbourhood surrounding the Streams Healthy Neighbourhood Hub and the individuals who utilize the services at Streams. Ultimately, the data was collected to assess the lack of access to health care and mental health resources.

- What is the size of the dataset?
There are 104 observations within the dataset

- Unit of observation?
1 person
